mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings (user_id, trade_ingested_enabled, tendency_analyzed_enabled, simulation_completed_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tradeIngestedEnabled}, #{tendencyAnalyzedEnabled}, #{simulationCompletedEnabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trade_ingested_enabled = VALUES(trade_ingested_enabled), tendency_analyzed_enabled = VALUES(tendency_analyzed_enabled), simulation_completed_enabled = VALUES(simulation_completed_enabled), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
